from pathlib import Path
# msgpack map with short_message and ext value, pad to 512 bytes
p=bytearray()
p.append(0x82)
p.append(0xaa); p+=b'A'*10; p.append(0xa1); p+=b'x'
p.append(0xa1); p+=b'b'; p.append(0xc7); p.append(1); p.append(0); p.append(0x41)  # ext8 len=1 type=0 body='A'
p += b'\xc0'*(512-len(p))
Path('/workspace/poc_ext_top.msgpack').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p), p[:30].hex())
PY
